data.name: Survival Exorcist
data.detailed_description:
Survival Exorcist is a solo developer's medieval survival horror experience inspired by the golden age of 2000's action horror games. An ancient plague has transformed villagers into grotesque creatures, and the rescue train sent to contain the outbreak never reached the castle. As a trained female hunter from the Order of Exorcists, you must find the derailed train to deliver the sacred artifacts needed to save the lands from complete corruption.

Hunt corrupted creatures with your crossbow as you explore plague-ridden villages and ancient catacombs. Discover hidden items scattered throughout the environment to replenish your limited resources while balancing stealth takedowns with strategic combat encounters..

Unlock Hunter Mode after completing the main campaign. Try a relentless challenge to use the train through the map as you gather rare materials and hunt down corrupted bosses in a race against time. Experience authentic 2000 era visuals with modern accessibility as you take on the role of a skilled hunter in a world overrun by ancient evil.

Hunt corrupted beasts with your crossbow or use dagger in stealth across diverse environments in this atmospheric experience.
